artists.biography:
Steven John Wilson (born 3 November 1967) is an English musician, best known as the founder, lead guitarist, singer and songwriter of progressive rock band Porcupine Tree. He is involved in many other bands and musical projects both as musician and producer (including No-Man and Blackfield) and also maintains a solo career.
Wilson is a self-taught producer, audio engineer, guitar and keyboard player, playing other instruments as and where required (including bass guitar, concert harp, hammered dulcimer and flute).
He used to split his living time between Tel Aviv and London, England, but he no longer holds a permanent residence in Tel Aviv.

perplexity.description:
Steven Wilson’s eighth studio album, The Overview, released on 14 March 2025 via Fiction Records (Virgin Music Group), marks a significant return to progressive rock after his recent forays into electronic music. The album consists of two expansive tracks—“Objects Outlive Us” (23:17) and “The Overview” (18:27)—each structured as multi-part suites that blend classic prog elements with modern textures, including glistening electronics, post-rock, and atmospheric soundscapes. Inspired by the “overview effect,” the cognitive shift experienced by astronauts viewing Earth from space, the album explores themes of perspective, human existence, and the vastness of the cosmos. Wilson’s sound draws comparisons to seminal acts like Pink Floyd, Tangerine Dream, and Vangelis, but is updated for a contemporary context, featuring collaborations with Craig Blundell (drums), Adam Holzman (keyboards), and Randy McStine (guitars), as well as lyrics by XTC’s Andy Partridge on the “Objects: Meanwhile” section.

The Overview stands as a pivotal release in Wilson’s discography, representing his most ambitious and conceptually unified work since The Raven That Refused to Sing (And Other Stories). It follows 2023’s The Harmony Codex and is his first headlining solo tour in over seven years, underscoring its importance in his artistic trajectory. The album received strong critical acclaim for its compositional depth, emotional resonance, and sonic innovation, with reviewers highlighting its seamless integration of narrative and music. Its premiere at the BFI IMAX in London, accompanied by a specially commissioned film, further cemented its status as a landmark event in progressive rock for 2025.
